quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #3
										  					
  

35 Questions • Passing Score 28

questions.question: What does a solid yellow line on your side of the centerline mean?
questions.explanation: A solid yellow line means you cannot pass other vehicles. If there is a broken yellow line on the other side, only drivers on that side may pass. If both lines are solid, no one may pass from either direction.

questions.question: In winter, bridge surfaces may stay icy even after the rest of the road is dry.
questions.explanation: Bridges, overpasses, shaded areas, and curves freeze before other parts of the road. They stay icy longer even after the rest of the roadway is clear and dry.

questions.question: Illinois law says you must use headlights when you use windshield wipers.
questions.explanation: Illinois law requires you to turn on your headlights whenever you use your windshield wipers.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange diamond-shaped signs mark construction, maintenance, and utility work areas. They help drivers and pedestrians stay safe in dangerous zones. Traffic fines may double in areas with these signs.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road splits. You must go either right or left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road splits. You must go either right or left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the road splits ahead and you must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: At a stop sign with no crosswalk, you must stop before entering the intersection.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, stop at the stop line if one exists. If there is no stop line, stop before the crosswalk. If there is no crosswalk, stop before entering the intersection.

questions.question: When turning left at an intersection, what should you do?

options.text: Always yield to oncoming traffic and pedestrians.
Oncoming traffic and pedestrians must yield to you.
Never yield to oncoming traffic and pedestrians.

questions.correctAnswerText: Always yield to oncoming traffic and pedestrians.
questions.explanation: When turning left, let oncoming traffic and pedestrians go first. You may only turn when the intersection is clear and signals allow it.

questions.question: When turning left, drivers must yield to:
questions.explanation: Drivers turning left must let oncoming vehicles go first. You can only turn when you can do so safely without affecting oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What is the correct way to make a right turn?

options.text: Signal, slow down, and move to the lane closest to the center line before turning.
Signal, slow down, and move to the lane closest to the right curb before turning.
Stay in the right lane, then move toward the middle of the street before turning.

questions.correctAnswerText: Signal, slow down, and move to the lane closest to the right curb before turning.
questions.explanation: Before turning right, use your turn signal. Slow down and approach from the right lane, staying as close to the right curb as possible.

questions.question: From top to bottom, what is the correct order of traffic light colors?
questions.explanation: From top to bottom, traffic lights are ordered: red, yellow, and green. This is standard in all locations.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign is placed on one-way streets and roads where you cannot enter. You may see it if you try to enter an expressway ramp the wrong way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you about a steep or long hill ahead. The hill may have sharp curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A yellow triangle sign with black letters means no passing zone. It appears on the left side of two-lane roads where you cannot pass other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided red sign means "stop."

questions.question: If you are convicted of passing a stopped school bus illegally, your driving privileges will be suspended.
questions.explanation: A conviction for passing a stopped school bus with flashing lights will result in suspension of your driver license. If the vehicle owner was not driving, they must tell the State's Attorney's Office who was driving, or the vehicle registration will be suspended for three months.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and do not use your brakes.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.

questions.explanation: This orange warning sign tells you that road work is coming up. Stay alert for temporary traffic control devices when driving through a work zone.

questions.question: You do not need to allow as much distance when following a motorcycle as when following a car.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles can stop faster than cars in dry conditions. You should keep three to four seconds of distance behind a motorcycle so the rider has time to move in an emergency.

questions.question: What color are temporary signs used in construction and maintenance work areas?
questions.explanation: All temporary signs in work zones have orange backgrounds with black writing and symbols.

questions.question: What do "No passing zone" signs tell drivers?

options.text: That it is not safe to pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: That it is not safe to pass.
questions.explanation: A "No passing zone" sign means you cannot pass other vehicles in that area. You are likely in an area where you cannot see far ahead, making it unsafe to pass.

questions.question: Any amount of alcohol in the blood can affect a driver's:
questions.explanation: Even small amounts of alcohol can hurt your judgment and physical coordination. This makes driving unsafe, even at blood alcohol levels below the legal limit. Driving under the influence of alcohol can result in criminal charges.

questions.question: Which statement about large trucks is true?

options.text: They take longer to stop than passenger vehicles.
They all have air brakes that allow them to stop quickly.
They are more maneuverable than passenger vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: They take longer to stop than passenger vehicles.
questions.explanation: Large trucks need more distance to stop than other vehicles at the same speed. A passenger vehicle at 55 mph can stop within 400 feet. A large truck at the same speed needs almost 800 feet to stop.

questions.question: Before changing lanes, you should check your mirrors and:

options.text: Never look over your right shoulder.
Always slow down in your traffic lane.

questions.explanation: Before changing lanes, look over your shoulder to check behind you. This ensures no vehicles are in the lane you want to enter. Also make sure no other drivers are moving into the same spot from another lane.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn of hazards. Orange warning signs are used in construction and maintenance areas.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a yield sign is coming. Slow down when you see this warning sign.

questions.question: Motorists are not required to yield to pedestrians walking against the traffic light.
questions.explanation: You must always yield to pedestrians. Pedestrians may sometimes misjudge traffic signals and cross against the light.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts drivers that pedestrians may cross ahead. You must stop and stay stopped until the pedestrian is completely across the road.

questions.question: If you become tired while driving, the best thing to do is:

options.text: Stop to rest or change drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop to rest or change drivers.
questions.explanation: If you become tired, stop to rest or have someone else drive. Tiredness slows your reactions and dulls your mind, making driving unsafe.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign indicates a crosswalk, whether marked on the pavement or not. Be alert and let pedestrians cross safely.

questions.question: You must use your low beams when you are:
questions.explanation: Use low beams in fog, snow, rain, or mist. High beams reflect off precipitation and create glare, making it harder to see. Some vehicles have fog lights that should be used with low beams.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows where pedestrians cross the road. Watch for people walking across.

questions.question: When you see an emergency vehicle with flashing lights approaching, you must:

options.text: Keep your speed and stay in your lane until it passes.
Move to the right lane and drive slowly until it passes.
Pull to the edge of the road and stop until it passes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull to the edge of the road and stop until it passes.
questions.explanation: When you see an emergency vehicle with flashing lights, pull to the right edge of the road and stop. On one-way streets, move toward the nearest edge.

questions.question: If a truck or bus is turning right where you also need to turn right, you should:

options.text: Turn quickly before the truck or bus moves.
Wait until the truck or bus finishes turning.
Squeeze between the truck or bus and the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait until the truck or bus finishes turning.
questions.explanation: Do not try to fit your vehicle between a turning truck or bus and the curb. This can cause a serious crash. Wait until the truck or bus completes its turn.

questions.question: When following any vehicle at night, you should dim your headlights.
questions.explanation: Dim your headlights when following any vehicle, including trucks and motorcycles, at night.

questions.question: What does a sign with this shape mean?
questions.explanation: A diamond-shaped yellow sign warns of possible danger ahead. Orange diamond-shaped signs warn of dangers in or near work areas.
